title: AiVanceJobApplication
description: Tracked job application lifecycle model managing pipeline stages, linked resume versions, cover letters, recruiter contacts, chronological timeline events, and actionable tasks.

id.description: Unique identifier for this tracked application

jobId.description: Foreign key reference to target job posting

resumeVersionId.description: Foreign key reference to specific resume version submitted

coverLetterId.description: Foreign key reference to tailored cover letter document

recruiterId.description: Foreign key reference to primary recruiter contact

stage.description: Current pipeline stage of the job application

salaryTarget.description: Target compensation discussed or submitted for this application

notes.description: Freeform user notes, interview impressions, or debrief comments

timeline.description: Chronological audit trail of stage changes and milestone interactions

tasks.description: Actionable follow-up checklist items (e.g. thank you notes, prep tasks)

appliedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when application was formally submitted

createdAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when entry was created

updatedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when application was last modified

title.description: Event headline (e.g., 'Initial Recruiter Phone Screen Completed')

timestamp.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when event took place

notes.description: Additional event notes or debrief points

dueDate.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when task is due
